Name: Shammah, Son of Jesse
Summary: Shammah, Jesse's third son, was passed over by Samuel at the anointing and served in Saul's army at Elah. He is also called Shimea and Shimeah in the record of David's family.
KeyStory: Shammah was the third son presented to Samuel and passed over, then stood with his brothers against Goliath's army.
RelatedPeople: Jesse; King David; Eliab, Son of Jesse; Abinadab, Son of Jesse
LifeLesson: The same man can be remembered under more than one name — God knows each one.
